Turkey Tail Extract – 120 Capsules | Host Defense Turkey Tail Mushroom Extract

Turkey Tail Extract – 120 Capsules

Organic turkey tail extract Number of capsules: 120 caps

Capsule size: Size 0

Net Content Capsules: 400mg

Dosage: 2x daily 1-2 capsules during the meal with water.

Common names: Elfenbankje, turkey tail fungus

What is turkey tail extract | Turkey Tail Extract – 120 Caps;

Turkey Tail (Trametes Versicolor) is the most researched mushroom for its medicinal properties. Studies have been done into the effect of this mushroom in various types of cancer and viruses. It was investigate whether this mushroom can contribute to the reduction of these cells and viruses by increasing the immune system.

Turkey Tail Extract Dosage:

400 mg organic Turkey Tail (Coriolos Versicolor) extract of 100% fruiting body (mushroom). It is a full spectrum extract obtain by means of H2O and ethanol. This is to get the most out of the fruiting bodies. It contains 30% polysaccharides of which about 90% are beta-glucans.

Excipients: Magnesium Citrate and Silicon Dioxide

Can provide assistance with:

– Complaints such as flu, colds, herpes and even chronic fatigue.

– Anti-aging; makes the skin elastic and supple and can provide strong and shiny hair

– Support in autoimmune diseases.

– The probiotics in the mushroom allow the body to create good bacteria in the stomach and intestines.

Host Defense Turkey Tail Mushroom Extract Warning:

Keep out of reach of children.

Consult your doctor before use if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or have health problems.

This is a dietary supplement and should be use as such.
